title: biophytum molle
intro: Biophytum molle, commonly known as "Kulthi" or "Malabar spinach," is a type of succulent plant that belongs to the family Oxalidaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Biophytum molle include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide relief from various health conditions.
